name: Safe wrapper local guarantees require wrapper identity fixture

applicability.reason: Supported. C053 denies that a safe wrapper's language-native object identity, destructor timing, thread model, allocator, exception type, generic type or vtable layout is an Iris stable ABI. `cpp_wrapper.cpp` is compiled as C++ and deliberately HAS all of those - a class with a virtual destructor, a vtable and a template - and none of them crosses: every exported entry takes and returns C integers only, and the header itself is included with C linkage so the ABI negotiated against is the C one. The wrapper reports the negotiated C major and confirms no C++ construct crosses, which is the wrapper-local boundary C053 fixes.
